title: Beyond the Pail | Official Book Trailer | Andrew M. Davidson
text:
A diamond can hide a wound. A nation can hide behind a lie. But truth always remembers.

"The diamond looked pure under the store light. That was the first lie."

BEYOND THE PAIL is a literary thriller about blood, beauty, witness and truth.

John Whitaker lives inside the polished world of wealth, where suffering arrives filtered through glass, distance, and elegant language. Kofi Badu lives beneath that world, in the mud and violence of a diamond field where survival itself is taxed by power. When a hidden route begins to fail, their lives collide, exposing the machinery that turns blood into luxury, faith into resistance, and truth into a threat.
